name: Exterior Porch Floor Finish Coat
intent: Finish coat by substrate + QT + method. Acrylic sealer (QT2 concrete), porch enamel (QT3/QT4), polyurea (QT5 concrete). Step detail when has_steps.
doctrine: Porch floor finish. QT2 concrete = acrylic sealer (self-priming, 2 coats). QT2 wood = single coat enamel. QT3/QT4 = porch enamel (2 coats) by method. QT5 = polyurea (roll only). Step detail 3 EA/hr (20 min/step) when has_steps. Spray+backroll is 2-crew. QT modifier applies to qt_scaled tasks.
